citationText: 11. Two technical standards for teletext have emerged: World System Teletext (WST) and the North American Basic Teletext Specification (NABTS). Originally developed in the U.K. for use with PAL video, WST is the more commonly used standard worldwide and is used by some U.S. broadcasters. NABTS, a more sophisticated system, has been used by CBS and Canadian broadcasters.
